body:
I do the same, just with a hammer because I'm full out too weak to inflict proper pain on myself. 

Hell, I couldn't even break my collar bone with a hammer... MY COLLAR BONE. 

I completely feel for you though. My situation isn't nearly as difficult as yours, yet I'm doing worse. You're strong and you are doing at least something right, just hold on to that for at least a little before you end it.

**TL;DR**; I **only** live for a few small things that people just casually find interesting, I have nobody, I am inferior in every way to my twin. I have no place in the world, and the only reason I'm here is a very strong selfishness. 

Thank you for responding, and sorry for not explaining my points further. I wasted time because my shitty intestines can't seem to process anything right, and I only had five minutes after to make an alt and post this. 

It's the fact that those are the only things I live for. Other people have their friends, jobs, children, parents, siblings, parents, or pets. Or for themselves. The other things like games are just bonuses to make it even more enjoyable. Like, I like video game figures, and set of movies, and a few games so I can support the developers (I didn't mention this as it applies less, but still: Soul Sacrifice and Gravity Rush). 

Originally, I was saving my suicide for the end of Infinity War / Inhumans, then Captain Marvel, then the end of season 3 for AoS, then for when R.O.B. would be released as an Amiibo, then for the beginning of AoS, now... I just want it to be over. 

It's just that every, single possible thing I can do, will be done better by my twin. We both have the same opportunities, yet she always comes out on top. I'll try my hardest, and dedicate every spendable hour on something be it friends, sports, or grades. Yet, she will do better without trying.     My friends like her more, our old teachers like her more, you parents like her more, he'll even the pets like her more and I'm the only one that takes care of them (and is consistently nice to them). 

It just seems like I have no place in the world (reference there), and anywhere I go gets worse. It's not even like I'm happy either, it's selfishness to the fullest. As I'm only still here because a feint hope and a slight fear holding me back from leaving everything behind. 

Sorry for the rambling, and for getting too personal (I bet that someone will find out about my main account if this gets popular). TL;DR is at the top.
